title: Inquiry response watch
description: The customer advisor drafts a grounded reply to each waiting inquiry and attaches the evidence it rests on. Sending is a human stage by construction — anything leaving the business under its own name is never an unattended act.

advance.condition: Every waiting inquiry has a draft reply whose every claim cites recorded evidence.
The accountable owner sends the reply, edits it first, or declines to answer.

stopConditions.condition: No waiting inquiry is without a draft reply.
The inquiry store cannot be read — the run stops and reports, and never drafts a reply to an inquiry it could not read.
More than 25 drafts in one run — the run stops and escalates rather than generating a queue nobody can review.

measures.description: Waiting inquiries given a grounded draft reply.
Age of the longest-waiting unanswered inquiry.

reviewPoint.description: Reviewed monthly whether or not it moved: an activity that has reported nothing for a month is as likely to be broken as to be reassuring.
